## Major section inventory

- Master Brand Bible: identity statement, core rule, final direction, visual thesis, aesthetic DNA, visual modes, principles, color, typography, texture, document layout, product surfaces, editorial voice, quality checklist, negative prompts.
- Agent specification: mission, project management, directories, component ecosystem, competencies, visual-mode discipline, tokens, typography, container/classification patterns, interactions, document types, animation, accessibility, workflow, success metrics.
- Roadmap: foundations; Polaroid/evidence system; document refactor; noir canvas; content system; marketing; advanced features; quality control.
- Polaroid spec: `PolaroidFrame`, `PolaroidEvidenceCard`, `DistressedPolaroid`, `TapedPolaroid`, `PolaroidStack`, `PolaroidContactSheet`; CSS starter; 12 explicitly requested story states.
- Design Canon guide: philosophy, colors, typography, containers, classification, interaction, component styling, motion, responsive behavior, accessibility, performance, workflow.
- Comprehensive prompt library: 58 H2 headings consisting of three opening collections plus 55 numbered chapters, ending with “The One Rule That Matters Most.”

## Recommended implementation shape

Use CSF `.stories.tsx`, not MDX:

- `brand-bible-overview.stories.tsx`
- `brand-bible-identity.stories.tsx`
- `brand-bible-design-canon.stories.tsx`
- `brand-bible-foundations.stories.tsx`
- `brand-bible-canvas-studies.stories.tsx`
- `brand-bible-components.stories.tsx`
- `brand-bible-prompts.stories.tsx`
- `brand-bible-operations.stories.tsx`
- `brand-bible-source-archive.stories.tsx`

Back these with one reusable `BrandBibleDocument` renderer using the existing Markdown/GFM stack and an auto-generated heading TOC. Add specialized token, image, PDF, HTML-source, and plain-text renderers.

Strong recommendation: render the Brand Bible as source/reference material with status notices. Do not silently promote every statement to current product canon. `docs/vision/DESIGN_REGISTERS.md` explicitly rejects a rigid mode registry, while `06_DESIGN_TOKENS.ts` and older Bible documents prescribe one. Current `DESIGN.md` also uses OKLCH Microfilm Dark tokens, while the starter token source uses light-paper hex colors.
